text: Learning a new skill can be exciting, but it also takes time and effort. First, you need to practise regularly, even if it is just for a short time each day. Patience is important because you will not become an expert quickly. There are many resources you can use, such as books, videos, or apps, and they can help you learn faster. It is also useful to track your progress, for example by writing down what you have learned each week. Finally, stay motivated by remembering why you started. Celebrate small successes, and do not give up when things get difficult.
